body_md:
Tujuan: meng-clone FreeMind (aplikasi mind mapping Java, format file `.mm` berbasis XML) menjadi aplikasi web statis (tanpa backend) yang merender & menyunting mind map di HTML Canvas 2D.

Referensi prior art: FreeMind (Java/Swing, SourceForge; format `.mm`), Freeplane (fork modern). Format `.mm`: `<map version>` → `<node TEXT="..." POSITION="..." FOLDED="true"><font/><icon/><edge/><cloud/><arrowlink/><node .../></node>`, plus `<richcontent>`, atribut, dan `ID`.

Rencana arsitektur:
- Model internal JS: node {id, text, position, folded, style, children[]}.
- Parser/emitter `.mm` (DOMParser untuk import; serializer untuk export) dua arah.
- Layout otomatis tree (kiri/kanan) + edge bezier; penyembunyian subtree saat folded.
- Renderer Canvas 2D dengan viewport (pan/zoom), hit-testing untuk seleksi/drag.
- Interaksi: tambah/edit/hapus node, Tab/Enter insert, drag, keyboard shortcuts ala FreeMind.
- Persistensi: import/export `.mm` + localStorage; build statis (deploy).

Batasan/clone target: tanpa kolaborasi realtime, tanpa plugin FreeMind, fokus parity fitur inti.
title: Lingkup: FreeMind clone ke web statis (Canvas 2D)

body_md:
Sumber: `github.com/jiangxin/freemind-mmx` (FreeMind 0.9-era, commit `a3674b0`), 529 file Java, paket utama `freemind`.

Peta paket (relatif `freemind/freemind/`):
- `main/` — bootstrap, XMLElement (NanoXML 2 Lite), Tools, HtmlTools, Resources.
- `controller/` — `Controller` (Swing), assembly menu/toolbar, listener mouse/drag/drop, framework transaksi aksi berbasis XML.
- `modes/` — model inti: `MindMap`, `MindMapNode`, `NodeAdapter`, `EdgeAdapter`, `XMLElementAdapter`, `ControllerAdapter`, `MindMapLinkRegistry`.
- `modes/mindmapmode/` — mode editable: `MindMapController`, `MindMapMapModel`, `MindMapNodeModel`, `actions/`, `listeners/`.
- `modes/common/`, `filemode/`, `browsemode/` — listener bersama & mode read-only.
- `view/mindmapview/` — seluruh rendering Swing: `MapView`, `NodeView`, `MainView` (+ Fork/Bubble/Root), edge views, layout.
- `accessories/plugins/`, `plugins/` — plugin opsional.

Koreksi: TIDAK ada kelas `MindMapLayoutStrategy`/`bruteForceLayout`. Layout = per-container `LayoutManager` (`MindMapLayout`) + `NodeViewLayout` per node.

10 kelas terpenting untuk reimplementasi (urut prioritas):
1. `modes/NodeAdapter.java` — model data; serializer di L1116.
2. `view/mindmapview/MapView.java` — canvas/scene, seleksi, navigasi, zoom, viewport.
3. `view/mindmapview/NodeView.java` — view per-node, bounds, orkestrasi paint, folding, hit-test.
4. `view/mindmapview/NodeViewLayoutAdapter.java` (+ Left/Right/VerticalRoot) — algoritma layout.
5. `modes/XMLElementAdapter.java` (+ `main/XMLElement.java`) — parsing `.mm`.
6. `modes/mindmapmode/MindMapController.java` — aksi, glue clipboard.
7. `view/mindmapview/MainView.java` (+ Fork/Bubble/Root) — menggambar kotak node.
8. `view/mindmapview/EdgeView.java` (+ Bezier/Linear/Sharp*) — menggambar edge & control point.
9. `modes/mindmapmode/actions/EditAction.java` (+ `EditNodeTextField`) — editing inline + transaksi teks.
10. `modes/mindmapmode/listeners/MindMapMouseMotionManager.java` + `modes/common/CommonNodeKeyListener.java` + `MapView.move` — interaksi.
title: Riset sumber FreeMind — peta arsitektur

body_md:
Parser: `main/XMLElement.java` (NanoXML 2 Lite, bukan SAX/DOM). Handler: `modes/XMLElementAdapter.java`. Migrasi format lama via XSLT (`main/Tools.getUpdateReader`, L1022).

Elemen yang didispatch (`XMLElementAdapter` L145–172): `node`, `edge`, `cloud`, `arrowlink`, `linktarget`, `font`, `attribute`, `attribute_layout`, `map`, `attribute_registry`, `attribute_name`, `attribute_value`, `icon`, `hook`, `<richcontent TYPE="NODE|NOTE">`.

Atribut node (baca, L429–473): `TEXT`, `ENCRYPTED_CONTENT`, `CREATED`, `MODIFIED`, `FOLDED`, `POSITION` (left/right), `COLOR`, `BACKGROUND_COLOR`, `LINK`, `STYLE`, `ID`, `VSHIFT`, `VGAP`, `HGAP`.
- `edge`: `STYLE`, `COLOR`, `WIDTH`.
- `cloud`: `COLOR`.
- `arrowlink`: `STYLE`, `ID`, `COLOR`, `DESTINATION`, `REFERENCETEXT`, `STARTINCLINATION`, `ENDINCLINATION`, `STARTARROW`, `ENDARROW`, `WIDTH`.
- `font`: `SIZE`, `NAME`, `BOLD`, `ITALIC` (+`UNDERLINE` saat tulis).
- `icon`: `BUILTIN`; `attribute`: `NAME`,`VALUE`.

Urutan nesting saat menulis (`NodeAdapter.save()` L1116–1370): `<node TEXT>` → `<richcontent>` → `ENCRYPTED_CONTENT` → `<edge>` → `<cloud>` → `<arrowlink>`/`<linktarget>` → attr FOLDED/POSITION/ID/COLOR/STYLE/VGAP/HGAP/VSHIFT/LINK/CREATED/MODIFIED → `<font>` → `<icon>` ×N → `<hook>` ×N → `<attribute>` ×N → children rekursif (streaming, tanpa DOM penuh).

Edge model: `EdgeAdapter` (STYLE linear|bezier|sharp_linear|sharp_bezier; WIDTH_PARENT=-1, WIDTH_THIN=0).
ID: prefix `ID_`, dialokasikan di `MindMapLinkRegistry` (L120–370); hanya diserialisasi bila node jadi target link (`sSaveOnlyIntrinsicallyNeededIds`). Link lokal = `#<ID>`.

Implikasi web: parser memakai DOMParser (import) dan serializer manual/streaming (export); model `{id,text,folded,position,style,edge,font,icons,richcontent,attributes,children[]}`.
title: FreeMind — model data & format .mm (XML)

body_md:
Scene graph: `MapView` (JComponent) berisi `NodeView` per node. Tiap `NodeView` memuat `MainView` (kotak node, subclass JLabel) + opsional motion/folding view. EDGE BUKAN komponen — digambar oleh NodeView induk.

`NodeView`: `SPACE_AROUND=50` (L115); `paint` L1519 → cloud, `paintCloudsAndEdges` L1491–1512 (translate ke origin anak, paint cloud anak, lalu `NodeViewFactory.getEdge(child).paint(child,g)`), `super.paint`, reset stroke. Hit-test `contains` L1562 / `getInnerBounds` L1556 di-inset SPACE_AROUND.

`MainView`: `MIN_HOR_NODE_SIZE=10` (L52); `getPreferredSize` L89 (padding +12px lebar, +4px tinggi; terapkan zoom; substitusi "!" untuk node kosong). Geometri abstrak per style: `getCenterPoint/getLeftPoint/getRightPoint` (L246–250). Style: `RootMainView` (elips), `ForkMainView` (gaya fork), `BubbleMainView` (rounded rect, `DEF_STROKE`).

Edge: `EdgeView` base — `source=target.getVisibleParentView()`, `createStart/createEnd` (L61–69), `getStroke` L80 (`BasicStroke(width*zoom)`), `getEclipsedStroke` L101 (putus-putus bila target hidden). `BezierEdgeView`: `CubicCurve2D`, `XCTRL=12`, `CHILD_XCTRL=20`, `update()` L42–57 (control point dgn sign sisi; root source → sourceSign 0).

Layout (2 tingkat):
1. `MindMapLayout` (LayoutManager) — `BORDER=30`, `MINIMAL_LEAF_WIDTH=150`; root di `(calcXBorderSize,calcYBorderSize)`; sizing `2*border+root`.
2. `NodeViewLayoutAdapter` (algoritma nyata): `getChildContentHeight(isLeft)` L178 = Σ(child height + cloud) + `vGap*(n-1)`; `getChildVerticalShift` L205; `getChildHorizontalShift` L230; `placeRightChildren` L263 / `placeLeftChildren` L317 (set posisi dari content bounds + hGap + cloud; majukan y sebesar child height - 2*spaceAround + vGap + cloud/2).
- `LeftNodeViewLayout`/`RightNodeViewLayout`: ukur konten, center thd tumpukan anak, in/out point dari `MainView.getLeftPoint/getRightPoint`.
- `VerticalRootNodeViewLayout`: menangani tumpukan kiri DAN kanan root; out-point common atau irisan elips L101–117 (`atan` + radius elips).

Implikasi web Canvas 2D: layout = rekursi bottom-up meniru getChildContentHeight → layout() → placeLeft/RightChildren; edge digambar dalam pass induk, sebelum/sesudah kotak node; hit-test harus memperhitungkan inset SPACE_AROUND.
title: FreeMind — rendering Java2D & algoritma layout

body_md:
Struktur menu: `mindmap_menus.xml` (root repo) memetakan `<menu_action field="X" key_ref="keystroke_Y"/>`. Default keystroke di `freemind.properties` L144–266.

Shortcut inti (untuk parity):
- `keystroke_add`=ENTER (sibling belakang); `keystroke_add_sibling_before`=shift+ENTER; `keystroke_add_child`=INSERT; `add_child_mac`=TAB.
- `keystroke_edit`=F2; `edit_long_node`=alt+ENTER; `toggle_folded`=SPACE; `toggle_children_folded`=ctrl+SPACE.
- `delete_child`=DELETE; `moveToRoot`=ESCAPE.
- Navigasi spasial: E/D/S/F (up/down/left/right); `node_up/down`=ctrl+UP/DOWN.
- `follow_link`=ctrl+ENTER; `add_arrow_link`=ctrl+L; `add_local_link`=alt+L; `set_link`=ctrl+K.
- Format: ctrl+I/B/U (italic/bold/underline); `toggle_cloud`=ctrl+shift+B.
- Undo/redo ctrl+Z / ctrl+Y; cut/copy/paste ctrl+X/C/V; select_all ctrl+A; select_branch ctrl+shift+A; find ctrl+F / ctrl+G.
- File: ctrl+N/O/S, ctrl+shift+S. Zoom: alt+UP/DOWN. Font size: ctrl+±.

Objek aksi: field di `MindMapController` (L313–571): `newChild, newSibling, newPreviousSibling, edit, editLong, deleteChild, toggleFolded, toggleChildrenFolded, nodeUp, nodeDown, fork, bubble, bold, italic, underlined, cloud, edgeColor, nodeColor, addArrowLinkAction, addLocalLinkAction, moveNodeAction, joinNodes, find, findNext, EdgeStyle_*, EdgeWidth_*, patterns[]`. Binding accelerator di `ControllerAdapter` L751–794 (`KeyStroke.getKeyStroke`).

Alur edit: `EditAction.edit(KeyEvent, addNew, editLong)` L104 → pilih editor: inline `EditNodeTextField` (L257) / `EditNodeWYSIWYG` / `EditNodeDialog` / `EditNodeExternalApplication`. `setNodeText` L297 mencatat transaksi do/undo. `NewChildAction.addNew` L103 menangani NEW_CHILD, NEW_CHILD_WITHOUT_FOCUS, NEW_SIBLING_BEFORE/BEHIND; menghitung index & sisi (isLeft).

Interaksi: `NodeView` memasang forwarder listener (`NodeMouseMotionListener`, `MapMouseMotionListener`, `NodeKeyListener`, `NodeMotionListener`, `NodeDragListener`, `NodeDropListener`).
- Mouse: `CommonNodeMouseMotionListener` — klik seleksi, double-click edit, popup. `MindMapMouseMotionManager` — panning latar + drag arrow-link. `MindMapNodeMotionListener` — drag node dgn Robot + auto-scroll.
- Keyboard: `CommonNodeKeyListener.keyPressed` L93 — arah/PAGE → `c.getView().move(e)` L120; HOME/END/BACKSPACE → mulai edit; tombol printable → mulai edit (kalau `key_type_adds_new`, tambah node); key arah dapat diremap.
- Navigasi/seleksi: `MapView.getVisibleLeft/Right` (~580–641), `getVisibleNeighbour` L643, `move` L682, `selectAsTheOnlyOneSelected` L785, `toggleSelected` L813, `selectBranch` L856, viewport `scrollNodeToVisible` L514 (extraWidth), zoom `getZoom/setZoom` L1097/L1105.
- Drag&drop: `NodeDragListener` (aksi MOVE default; LINK via right/Mac-meta; COPY via middle), `NodeDropListener` drop-as-son/sibling kiri/kanan via `MainView.setDraggedOver/dropAsSibling/dropPosition`.

Implikasi web: implementasi state seleksi multi-node, navigasi spasial, pan/zoom viewport, inline editor yang diposisikan di atas node (kanan-align untuk leaf kiri), dan transaksi undo/redo.
title: FreeMind — aksi, shortcut, & interaksi

body_md:
Dari riset source FreeMind (commit a3674b0). Rujukan: freemind/freemind/modes/NodeAdapter.java, modes/XMLElementAdapter.java, modes/mindmapmode/MindMapXMLElement.java.

## Model node (NodeAdapter)
Field & default (NodeAdapter.java:75-127):
- text: `userObject`/`xmlText` (default "no text")
- folded: boolean (atribut FOLDED true/false)
- position: LEFT=-1, RIGHT=1, UNKNOWN=0 (NodeAdapter:81-83). POSITION hanya ditulis bila parent == root (NodeAdapter:1247-1249).
- style: STYLE (null=warisan). HGAP=20, VGAP=3, SHIFT=-2 (NodeAdapter:77-79). vGap/hGap/shiftY hanya ditulis bila != default (1280-1288).
- color (COLOR), backgroundColor (BACKGROUND_COLOR)
- link (LINK), id (ID hanya bila jadi target hyperlink lokal/arrowlink, 1253-1260)
- font (elemen child <font NAME SIZE BOLD ITALIC UNDERLINE>), icons (<icon BUILTIN>), edge (<edge>), cloud (<cloud>), arrowlink, richcontent, attribute, hook
- history CREATED/MODIFIED (1294-1302)

## Gaya (MindMapNode.java:50-55)
STYLE_FORK="fork", STYLE_BUBBLE="bubble", STYLE_AS_PARENT, STYLE_COMBINED.
Resolusi (NodeAdapter.getStyle, 374-406): null→root pakai property root_node_style / lain node_style; as_parent→ikut parent; combined→bubble bila folded, jika tidak fork.

## Format .mm (XML)
- Root `<map version>` → `<node TEXT="...">`.
- Atribut node baca/tulis: TEXT, FOLDED, POSITION, COLOR, BACKGROUND_COLOR, STYLE, ID, VSHIFT, VGAP, HGAP, LINK, CREATED, MODIFIED (XMLElementAdapter:429-475; NodeAdapter.save).
- Teks kaya: bila HTML → child `<richcontent TYPE="NODE">` (encoded), catatan → `<richcontent TYPE="NOTE">` (NodeAdapter:1150-1174). Encoding via HtmlTools.makeValidXml + unicodeToHTMLUnicodeEntity.
- Edge: atribut STYLE/COLOR/WIDTH (WIDTH="1" = thin) (XMLElementAdapter:305-312).
- Urutan serialisasi anak: edge, cloud, arrowlink, font, icon, hook, attribute (NodeAdapter:1184-1361); richcontent node/note lebih dulu (1150-1174).
- Impor: DOMParser bisa memetakan langsung; node class selalu MindMapNodeModel (tanpa plugin).

## Catatan implementasi web
- Parser: DOMParser → DFS bangun {id,text,folded,position,style,color,bg,edge,font,icons,richcontent,attrs,children[]}.
- Emitter: serializer dua arah yang hanya menulis atribut non-default (hemat & setara FreeMind).
- Tidak perlu plugin/hook/enkripsi; richcontent dirender sebagai teks/HTML terbatas.
title: Spesifikasi model node & format .mm (presisi)

body_md:
Rujukan: view/mindmapview/NodeViewLayoutAdapter.java, LeftNodeViewLayout.java, RightNodeViewLayout.java, VerticalRootNodeViewLayout.java, NodeView.java.

## Konstanta
- SPACE_AROUND = 50 (NodeView.java:115), di-zoom: map.getZoomed(SPACE_AROUND).
- vGap default 3, hGap default 20 (NodeAdapter:77-79).

## Primitif (NodeViewLayoutAdapter)
- getChildContentHeight(isLeft) (178-199):
  height = Σ_children( isLeft cocok ? child.content.height + child.additionalCloudHeight : 0 ) + vGap*(count-1).
- getChildVerticalShift(isLeft) (205-228): jumlahkan child.getShift() untuk shift<0 atau anak pertama; lalu kurangi (child.content.y - spaceAround) tiap anak; kurangi spaceAround bila ada anak. Hasil ≤ 0.
- getChildHorizontalShift() (230-257): untuk anak kiri candidate = -content.x - content.width - (visible? hGap + cloudHeight/2 : 0); anak kanan candidate = -content.x + (visible? hGap : 0); ambil min.

## Penempatan anak (dipakai root & non-root)
- placeRightChildren (263-311): baseX = content.x+content.width; y mulai content.y+childVerticalShift; tiap anak: y += cloud/2; shiftY<0 → setLocation(x,y); y -= shiftY; else y += shiftY; setLocation; y += child.height - 2*spaceAround + vGap + cloud/2. x = baseX + childHGap - content.x. view.size = (right, max(bottom, lastChild.bottom+cloud/2)).
- placeLeftChildren (317-362): simetris; x = baseX - childHGap - content.x - content.width.

## Non-root (Left/RightNodeViewLayout)
- Left (39-60): contentHeight=getChildContentHeight(true); x=max(spaceAround, -childHorizontalShift); bila visible, contentVerticalShift += (contentPrefH - contentHeight)/2; y=max(spaceAround,-shift); content.setBounds(x,y,prefW,prefH); placeLeftChildren.
- Right (39-62): x=max(spaceAround, -contentPrefW - childHorizontalShift) bila visible; placeRightChildren.

## Root (VerticalRootNodeViewLayout, 43-79)
- Hitung rightContentHeight/leftContentHeight & shift masing-masing; childHorizontalShift; x=max(spaceAround,-childHorizontalShift).
- Center vertikal konten relatif ke tiap sisi: rightShift += (prefH-rightH)/2; leftShift += (prefH-leftH)/2; y=max(spaceAround, -min(rightShift,leftShift)).
- placeLeftChildren lalu placeRightChildren; view.size = max dimensi kedua sisi.
- Root out-point: bila USE_COMMON_OUT_POINT_FOR_ROOT_NODE → mainView.left/right point; jika tidak → irisan elips via atan((p.y-c.y)/(p.x-c.x)) (+π bila kiri) → (c.x+cos·nW, c.y+sin·nH) (91-117).

## In/Out point edge (dipanggil EdgeView)
- Kiri: out=mainView.getLeftPoint(), in=getRightPoint() (LeftNodeViewLayout:78-87).
- Kanan: out=getRightPoint(), in=getLeftPoint() (RightNodeViewLayout:80-89).

## Implementasi web
- Layout satu lintasan bottom-up; simpan content size per node; tempatkan anak kiri & kanan terpisah di root.
- Gunakan sistem koordinat lokal per node lalu konversi ke koordinat kanvas (analog convertPointToAncestor).
title: Spesifikasi algoritma layout (kiri/kanan + root)

body_md:
Rujukan: view/mindmapview/MainView.java, ForkMainView.java, BubbleMainView.java, RootMainView.java, EdgeView.java, BezierEdgeView.java, LinearEdgeView.java, MapView.java, NodeView.java.

## Bentuk node (MainView subclasses)
- ForkMainView (34-136): gambar garis horizontal di bawah: g.drawLine(0, height-edgeWidth/2-1, width, height-edgeWidth/2-1) warna edge; alignment ALIGN_BOTTOM; getLeftPoint=(0,height-edge/2-1), getRightPoint=(width-1,height-edge/2-1), center=(w/2,h/2). edgeWidth default 1, untuk style sharp_* = maksimum width anak.
- BubbleMainView (33-156): g.drawRoundRect(0,0,w-1,h-1,10,10); alignment CENTER; left=(0,h/2), right=(w-1,h/2), center=(w/2,h/2); prefSize.width += 5; selected fillRoundRect.
- RootMainView (34-156): g.setColor(gray); g.drawOval(0,0,w-1,h-1) stroke 1.0; fillOval untuk background/selected; prefSize width*=1.1 height*=2; alignment CENTER.
- Ukuran node (MainView.getPreferredSize 89-120): pref = label size * zoom; width=+12, height=+4 (zoom); isEmpty→teks "!".

## Edge
- EdgeView.paint(target,g) (51-59): source = target.getVisibleParentView(); createEnd() = target.mainView.getMainViewInPoint(); createStart() = source.mainView.getMainViewOutPoint(target,end); lalu paint.
- BezierEdgeView (31-78): CubicCurve2D.Float; XCTRL=12 (dx kontrol di source), CHILD_XCTRL=20 (dx kontrol di child); sign = target.isLeft()?-1:1; sourceSign=0 bila source root & bukan common-out-point; control: (start.x + sign·XCTRL·zoom, start.y) dan (end.x - sign·CHILD_XCTRL·zoom, end.y).
- LinearEdgeView: garis lurus start→end (dash bila eclipsed).
- Stroke: width dari model edge; WIDTH_THIN→DEF_STROKE; eclipsed dash {3,9} (EdgeView:101-108).

## Edge digambar oleh parent
- Edge bukan objek kanvas terpisah: digambar dalam pass NodeView induk (EdgeView.paint dilakukan per target, source=parent).

## Viewport & interaksi
- Zoom via MapView.getZoom(); semua ukuran di-zoom dengan getZoomed().
- Hit-test node memakai inset SPACE_AROUND (NodeView:1557,1563).
- Seleksi: useSelectionColors → selectedColor; sebaliknya backgroundColor/textBackground.
- DragOver: gradien arah (NodeView.DRAGGED_OVER_SON kiri/kanan, SIBLING) (MainView.paintDragOver 174-196; RootMainView 66-80).
- follow-link region: bila node punya LINK (MainView.isInFollowLinkRegion 344-349).

## Aksi/shortcut inti (dari modes/mindmapmode/actions)
NewChildAction (INSERT/TAB), NewSiblingAction (ENTER), NewPreviousSiblingAction, DeleteChildAction (DELETE), ToggleFoldedAction (SPACE), ToggleChildrenFoldedAction, EditAction (F2), CopyAction, serta navigasi NodeDownAction dll.

## Implementasi web (Canvas 2D)
- Satu fungsi render per node: gambar edge (dari parent), lalu bentuk (fork=line / bubble=roundRect / root=oval), lalu teks.
- Transform kanvas untuk pan/zoom; hit-test pakai kotak node + inset.
- Editor inline: input absolut diposisikan di atas node (kanan-align untuk leaf kiri).
title: Spesifikasi rendering node, edge, viewport & interaksi

body_md:
Basis: source FreeMind commit a3674b0 (modes/mindmapmode/actions, modes/actions, view/mindmapview, controller/MenuBar, *.xsl). Status web = src/freemind-core.mjs + src/index.html.

SUDAH ADA di web:
- Render Canvas: root/bubble/fork, resolusi style node (fork/bubble/combined/as_parent), warna teks/gb/edge, font (size/bold/italic/underline/name), ikon BUILTIN + ikon link, fold indicator, 4 gaya edge, cloud, arrowlink + arrowhead.
- Layout kiri/kanan, hGap/vGap/shiftY (node motion), round-trip .mm (raw richcontent/note/attribute/icon/font/edge/cloud/arrowlink/attribute).
- Interaksi: select + multi-select (Shift+klik, rubber-band), pan/zoom (wheel/pinch/Fit), edit teks, tambah anak/saudara, hapus, fold + fold/unfold all, undo/redo, drag-drop reparent/reorder, clipboard C/X/V/D, pencarian Ctrl+F/F3, buka hyperlink (Ctrl+klik), impor/ekspor .mm.
- Headless SVG renderSVG.

BELUM ADA (gap), per kategori:
1. Rich text & catatan: editor WYSIWYG richcontent + toggle rich/plain (UseRichFormatting/UsePlainText, EditNodeWYSIWYG); editor+panel catatan (NOTE); panel/mode atribut (all/selected/hide), edit/hapus/impor atribut, dan FILTER atribut (controller/filter).
2. Ikon: pemilih ikon (menu ikon, keluarga ikon), hapus ikon terakhir (RemoveIcon) / semua (RemoveAllIcons).
3. Warna/gaya via UI: NodeColor, NodeBackgroundColor, NodeColorBlend; NodeStyleAction; Bold/Italic/Underline/FontFamily/FontSize (dialog+action); EdgeColor/EdgeStyle/EdgeWidth; Cloud tambah/hapus/warna.
4. Link/arrowlink edit: SetLinkByTextField, SetLinkByFileChooser, SetImageByFileChooser; AddArrowLink, RemoveArrowLink, ChangeArrowsInArrowLink, ColorArrowLink, ChangeArrowLinkEndPoints.
5. Struktur/navigasi: NodeUp (geser urutan), MoveNode/reset posisi, JoinNodes (gabung), SelectAll, SelectBranch, MoveToRoot, previous/next map, GotoLink target, opsi selection method (delayed/rectangle), auto-scroll saat drag.
6. File: New/Open/Save/Save As/Close/Reload/Revert/autosave/backup, Recent files, Print + Print Preview + Page setup.
7. Ekspor (XSLT): HTML/XHTML, PDF, SVG, PNG/JPG, Flash, Java applet, CSV, LaTeX article/book, OpenOffice Writer/Impress, OPML, WordML, MS Project, MS Excel, Twiki, Text, XBEL; Export branch. Impor: folder structure, Explorer favorites, linked branch, MindManager(.mmap), OPML, XBEL; drop file ke node.
8. Tampilan/preferensi: zoom in/out/reset via tombol/menu; toggle toolbar (atas/kiri); move map left/right; Preferences/Look&Feel/bahasa; tooltip node; layout root VERTIKAL (VerticalRootNodeViewLayout) — web hanya kiri/kanan; Blind icon; toggle "selection as rectangle".
9. Ekosistem/lanjutan: enkripsi peta (EncryptedMindMapNode); skrip Groovy + plugin/hook (NodeHook, MindMapControllerHook, ExportHook); time management/Reminder; kolaborasi/sharing; mode selain mindmap; banyak dokumen/jendela (menu Mindmaps); i18n.

Prioritas implementasi yang disarankan (parity inti): (a) editor catatan + atribut/panel, (b) pemilih ikon + warna/gaya/font UI, (c) edit link/arrowlink/cloud, (d) ekspor HTML+SVG+PNG, (e) layout root vertikal + zoom tombol, (f) NodeUp/Join/SelectBranch + navigasi keyboard.
title: Cross-check fitur FreeMind vs web canvas (gap analysis)

body_md:
Permintaan user: peta disimpan di peramban (localStorage) sehingga tetap ada sebelum diekspor ke file.

Implementasi (src/index.html):
- Kunci `freemind-web-canvas:mm.v1`. `loadLocal()`/`saveLocal()`/`clearLocal()`; tulis ditunda 400 ms (`scheduleSaveLocal`) dipanggil dari `relayout()` (setiap mutasi memanggil relayout). Bila init: `root = loadLocal() || parseMM(seed)`.
- Menu File ditambah: "Simpan di Peramban" (Ctrl+Shift+S), "Pulihkan dari Peramban", "Hapus Simpanan". Status kecil di toolbar (`#saveinfo`) menampilkan "Tersimpan di peramban ✓ <jam>". Ctrl+S tetap ekspor ke file; Ctrl+Shift+S simpan lokal.

Verifikasi (browser headless, Playwright di /tmp/pw/ls.mjs — di luar harness node renv karena butuh localStorage/DOM): hapus kunci → reload bersih (2 anak) → Tab tambah anak → tunggu debounce → key localStorage 568 byte → reload → 3 anak (bertahan).
